visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair and glasses stands inside a modern elevator with reflective metallic walls. She wears a white windbreaker over a white t-shirt and black shorts. She holds a smartphone with a character-print case in a selfie position. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor venue under a massive white tent structure. The woman walks through a dense crowd of people, most of whom are wearing identical white event t-shirts. The lighting is overcast and natural. (3) The woman joins a group of approximately 15 people under the tent. They are holding a long black banner with white text. They wave and cheer enthusiastically towards the camera. (4) The woman talks directly to the camera in a selfie shot, standing next to another woman in a similar white shirt. In the background, white tents and various event equipment are visible. (5) A large crowd of runners is seen from behind, passing under a blue starting arch labeled 'ELLE Run With Style'. The sky is grey and the ground appears damp. (6) A small toddler in a blue t-shirt and grey shorts runs along a paved road with yellow markings. Other runners' legs are visible in the background. (7) A high-angle shot shows the woman's feet in white sneakers and white socks with blue stripes as she walks on asphalt. (8) A long table covered in rows of white paper cups is shown. A hand reaches out to take a cup. Tents and participants are visible in the distance. (9) The woman walks along a green park path. A blue sign marks '1km'. A photographer sits on the brick-paved ground under a black umbrella. (10) The camera captures the woman's face from a low angle as she runs, her expression showing physical effort. She looks up toward the cloudy sky. (11) A group of runners moves toward a blue finish arch. Two men stand at the finish line holding a white banner. (12) Back at the gathering area, the woman and her group celebrate. They hold up gold-colored medals and printed placards, smiling and waving for a final group portrait.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track begins with low-level indoor resonance and the muffled sound of a mechanical lift mechanism. There is no music. (2) A sharp cut introduces a high-energy, four-on-the-floor electronic dance beat with bright synth stabs. A female voice speaks with a high-pitched, excited intonation, greeting the listener. (3) The audio texture shifts as the speaker joins a group. Multiple voices erupt into a loud collective cheer with high arousal and positive valence. A transient 'woo' sound effect is clearly audible. (4) The BGM continues as a steady background bed while the primary female speaker delivers a rhythmic narrative. Her breathing is audible, indicating physical activity. (5) A rhythmic thudding sound of footsteps becomes prominent in the mix, layered under the music. The speaker’s voice exhibits moderate breathiness as she comments on her fatigue. (6) The wind floor increases slightly as the speaker moves through an open area. The music swells in volume during a brief non-vocal transition. (7) Loud cheering and clapping sounds from a crowd are introduced in the final segment, synchronized with the music's climax. The track ends with a bright, sustained synthesizer chord and fading crowd chatter.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the creator's personal journey and social experience participating in the 'ELLE Run With Style' 5k race. It highlights themes of maternal self-care, community support from a church group, and the joy of physical achievement, intended to inspire other mothers to step out of their comfort zones.
